column1: # Public PowerPoint decks, with the PDF PowerPoint made of them when one is published, for the
# PowerPoint reader's crash test, text check and (decks with a PDF) page fidelity.
# Downloaded into tests/data/powerpoint-corpus/ (not committed; the fetch script comes with the crash test).
# Sources: data.gov.uk (each dataset's licence: OGL or CC BY where stated); open.canada.ca (Open Government
# Licence - Canada); data.gov.au (Geoscience Australia presentations; the catalogue gives no licence: see each
# dataset's page); data.e-gov.go.jp (soumu.go.jp, cio.go.jp, digital.go.jp: PDL1.0 or CC BY per dataset);
# GitHub HlidacStatu/UZIS_COVID_DATA (MIT; the raw file is base64, MIME-wrapped: the sha256 is of the decoded deck).
# A PDF is listed only when its Producer or Creator names Microsoft PowerPoint and its page count is the
# id, sha256 of the deck, its URL, sha256 of the PDF, its URL, language (most common lang of the runs),
